title: EscapeRoomGameState
description: The complete game state passed as OPA input on every policy call.

current_room.description: Room the player is currently in.

inventory.description: Items currently held by the player.

unlocked_rooms.description: Every room the player has legally entered so far (used by the wormhole reachability rule).

glyph_key_id.description: The integer id carried by the glyph_key item once decoded. null if not yet decoded.

epoch_phase.description: Scenario-injected phase. eclipse overrides the cursed_idol block.

glyph_index.description: Which glyph PNG to use for decode_glyph (0-3). Injected per scenario.

available_items.description: Items present in current_room that the player has not yet picked up. Required when action.type is 'take' or when computing allowed_actions.

action.description: The action being evaluated. Omit (or set to null) for allowed_actions queries.
